description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 as part of the receive page (relayed by Optimize; https://claude.ai/artifact/UxRskxPS2PDs3j1x5TF6Aq v2); split from fz-9x7.33.

try_match (runtime/src/park.rs) allocates two Vecs per attempt: the out buffer of bound values, and, since #707 (fz-9x7.32), the pinned words read from the frame when a receive pins values. The matcher writes into a buffer its caller owns (a reusable scratch on the Process that runs the matcher).

Signal: with fz-9x7.33, receive-site mallocs per message on g-msg ~4.5 -> 0 (GC's counting allocator).

Waits on the user's ruling on fz-9x7.28's design (forwarding map only for receive matches / project bound values on the receiver / re-bless 01592), which may change how bound values leave a matched message. Owner agreed between Optimize and GC after that ruling.
title: The matcher writes into a buffer its caller owns
